title: Corelib 61-target matrix and release evidence
body:
Fresh source-tip evidence on 2026-08-09 established the authoritative matrix at 61 targets, not the historical 42. The release CLI built in 23s and the explicit release runtime kit staged in 5.7s. With stdin bound to deterministic EOF, all 61 targets completed without a per-target hang: 20 passed and 41 failed. The earlier apparent hang was `Core.Input.Read` receiving SIGTTIN from a background PTY process group, not a compiler deadlock. Current shared failure clusters include exact assembled nominal ABI lookup, enum layout availability, generic type arguments, and ordinary codegen failures. Focused RED/GREEN fixes do not complete this task until a fresh source-tip 61/61 run and retained report pass.

**Linear:** [CYB-181](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-181/v04-recover-authoritative-61-target-corelib-matrix-and-bounded-harness)

subtasks.text: Record fresh 61-target source-tip baseline (20 pass / 41 fail)
Bind canonical Corelib gate stdin to deterministic EOF
Recover shared semantic ABI, enum-layout, and generic failure clusters
Record fresh 61/61 source-tip matrix with exact revisions and retained report
